legs.proof: TARGETED safe-apply LANDED. bash .tools/safe-apply.sh -chdir=infra/aws/terraform/globgrph apply -input=false -no-color -auto-approve on EXACTLY TEN -target addresses, rc 0, saved whole at deliverables/0.9.0_WK_NFRA_CLDGRPH~1/targeted_apply.txt: 'Apply complete! Resources: 4 added, 6 changed, 4 destroyed.' THE TEN, and why -target pulled six beyond the four the cell names: (1) aws_ecs_task_definition.comp_learns_producer, (2) .cse_producer, (3) .fedobs_producer, (4) .resource_summaries_producer -- the four the row moves, each REPLACED (a task-definition edit is a new revision, so 4 destroyed + 4 added is the revision bump, not a deletion of anything running); (5) aws_cloudwatch_event_target.comp_learns_producer_nightly, (6) aws_cloudwatch_event_target.fedobs_producer_nightly, (7) aws_scheduler_schedule.cse_producer_nightly -- the three DECLARED launchers, each referencing aws_ecs_task_definition.<x>.arn, which carries the REVISION, so Terraform re-points them in the SAME apply; (8) aws_iam_role_policy.comp_learns_producer_events_ecs, (9) aws_iam_role_policy.cse_producer_scheduler_ecs, (10) aws_iam_role_policy.fedobs_producer_events_ecs -- the launcher roles' ecs:RunTask grants, whose Resource is the SAME revision-scoped ARN (comp_learns_producer.tf:131 Resource = aws_ecs_task_definition.comp_learns_producer.arn). Omitting the three IAM policies would have produced a green apply and three nightly launches that cannot start -- the W1-S2 hazard measured on CG-s-15's apply. POST-APPLY 0-DIFF on the same ten (targeted_plan_post.txt): 'No changes. Your infrastructure matches the configuration.' UNSCOPED PLAN CONTROL (unscoped_plan_pre.txt, run against the live S3 backend BEFORE the apply, never applied), asserted BY ADDRESS LIST: 'Plan: 6 to add, 8 to change, 4 to destroy.' over FOURTEEN addresses = my ten plus FOUR foreign, all pre-existing drift left exactly as found: aws_glue_partition.tool_activity['rolling_log'] and ['rolling_log_summary'] (in-place), aws_glue_partition.tool_activity['routing'] (create), and aws_sns_topic_subscription.critical_surface_alerts_email (create) -- the last is the never-applied alert wiring the Andrew posture cfb741306 keeps DOWN and the C3 moratorium forbids this order to land. HALT GATE: rc 0 under the spine-v3 worker limb after the gate's own printed one-line identity remediation (row W1-S27); comp-tagauthz pre-apply gate PASSED. Terraform v1.9.8, the binary the issuer provisioned into this worktree, never the PATH substitute.

legs.proof: EVERY DECLARED LAUNCHER READS THE NEW REVISION, live (E2-AC3, targets_current.sh, rc 0): TARGETS_ON_PINNED_REVISION=3 of 3 declared launcher(s). events list-targets-by-rule opal-globgrph-comp-learns-producer-nightly -> .../globgrph-comp-learns-producer:2 = the family's ACTIVE ARN; events list-targets-by-rule opal-globgrph-fedobs-producer-nightly -> .../globgrph-fedobs-producer:2 = ACTIVE; scheduler get-schedule globgrph-cse-producer-nightly -> .../globgrph-cse-producer:2 = ACTIVE. All three read :1 BEFORE the apply, so the re-point is measured as a MOVE and not as a coincidence. The three launcher roles' revision-scoped ecs:RunTask grants moved in the SAME apply (legs L2 (8),(9),(10)), so no launcher can be pointed at a revision it may not run. THE FOURTH FAMILY HAS NO DECLARED LAUNCHER AND IS RECORDED AS ONE, not counted as a miss: globgrph-resource-summaries-producer is launched BY HAND (ad-hoc ecs run-task). Measured live by three instruments, none of which finds an automated launcher: (1) events list-rules over the whole default bus with list-targets-by-rule on EVERY rule -- exactly 3 rules carry an ECS TaskDefinitionArn (comp-learns, derive-runner, fedobs) and none is this family; (2) scheduler list-schedules = 19 schedules, the only globgrph one is globgrph-cse-producer-nightly; (3) pipes list-pipes = 1 pipe, opal-globgrph-projection-worker. Its Terraform declares only an output (resource_summaries_producer.tf:186) whose own description reads 'manual run-task', and its log group /ecs/globgrph-resource-summaries-producer holds exactly THREE streams, all on 2026-07-18 (20:58:14Z, 21:08:15Z, 21:11:04Z) -- one seeding session, no cadence since. Its next launch is whoever runs it and it will run revision 2, because that is the family's ACTIVE revision. Filed as row NFRA_CLDGRPH-W1-S28. NO LAUNCH WAS PROVOKED BY THIS ORDER: no ecs run-task, no update-service, no stop-task; the next scheduled fire (cse 03:30Z, comp-learns 04:00Z, fedobs 04:30Z) is the L9 seat's acceptance to read later.
